```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: setup

library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet") |> 
  mutate(launch_date_parsed = parse_date_time(launch_date, orders = c("ymd", "mdy")) |> as_date())
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet") |> 
  rename(category_description = description)

crypto <- prices |> 
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |> 
  left_join(categories, by = "category_id") |> 
  mutate(date = ymd(date_raw))
```

```{r}
crypto |> 
  group_by(date, category_name) |> 
  summarize(total_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(category_name = fct_reorder(category_name, total_market_cap, sum, .desc = TRUE)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = total_market_cap, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2022-05-09"), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2022-11-08"), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2022-05-09"), y = 1.02, label = "Luna / UST crash", hjust = 1, size = 3, vjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2022-11-08"), y = 1.02, label = "FTX collapse", hjust = 0, size = 3, vjust = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  labs(
    title = "Evolution of Cryptocurrency Market Share",
    subtitle = "Daily percentage share of total market capitalization across crypto categories (2018–2026)",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of Market Capitalization",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: Daily cryptocurrency market dataset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
